CustomField.description: This field is used in the commissions calculation process. Jira ticket SS-9445
CustomField.formula:
IF(NOT(Quota_Retirement_Eligible__c), 0, IF(NOT(Start_Date_in_Opp_Fiscal_Year__c), 0, IF(AND(NOT(Exclude_from_ARR__c), SBQQ__ProrateMultiplier__c >= 1), ARR_Amount__c, IF(AND(NOT(Exclude_from_ARR__c), SBQQ__ProrateMultiplier__c < 1), SBQQ__NetTotal__c, 0 ))))
/* IF(NOT(Quota_Retirement_Eligible__c), 0, IF(NOT(Start_Date_in_Opp_Fiscal_Year__c), 0, IF(AND(NOT(Exclude_from_ARR__c), SBQQ__ProrateMultiplier__c >= 1), ARR_Amount__c, IF(AND(NOT(Exclude_from_ARR__c), SBQQ__ProrateMultiplier__c < 1), SBQQ__NetTotal__c, IF(AND(TEXT(SBQQ__Quote__r.SBQQ__Opportunity2__r.Type) = 'New Customer', SBQQ__Quote__r.SBQQ__Opportunity2__r.NARR_New_ARR__c >= 250000, TEXT(Product_Line__c) = 'ESR', SBQQ__ProrateMultiplier__c >= 0.5), SBQQ__NetTotal__c * (SBQQ__ProrateMultiplier__c/2), IF(AND(TEXT(SBQQ__Quote__r.SBQQ__Opportunity2__r.Type) = 'New Customer', SBQQ__Quote__r.SBQQ__Opportunity2__r.NARR_New_ARR__c >= 250000, TEXT(Product_Line__c) = 'ESR', SBQQ__ProrateMultiplier__c < 0.5), SBQQ__NetTotal__c, 0 )))))) */
CustomField.label: Quota Retirement ARR
